text: Do you overthink every text, every move, or every word on a date? That's not confidence, that's perfectionism. And it's ruining things for you. The message I'm trying to convey today, stop being a perfectionist when it comes to dating or approaching women. Dating isn't about being flawless. If you wait for the perfect line, the perfect moment, the perfect vibe, you'll wait forever. And while you are stuck in your head, opportunities pass you by. So instead of obsessing over saying or doing everything right, focus on being real. Did you approach her? Did you express yourself? Did you ask her out? That's what matters. Most guys don't realize. If you set the bar too high, you'll always end up disappointed. But if you learn to appreciate small steps, you'll actually build momentum and confidence. Every time you take action, even if it's messy, you are winning. Because confidence grows through doing, not overthinking. The irony? When you stop chasing perfection and just enjoy the interaction, that's when you become most attractive. So stop chasing the Hollywood version of dating. Lower the pressure, enjoy the interactions, and let things unfold naturally. Because at the end of the day, dating isn't about being perfect. It's about being present.
